initial_review_questions: Keep the general experiment law and H<3/4 parameter domain separate from the piecewise-constant model; same observable grid does not imply identical experiments.
In Section 2, n=2^N while the block observations are indexed only below delta_n^-1. Check the empirical coefficient subscripts using 2^(N-j) without silently replacing N or delta.
The coarse H estimator on page 8 prints log, whereas the general construction prints log_2. Preserve the source and record the ambiguity separately.
Equation (5) has an extra 2^-j in the middle noise subscript; determine whether it is needed in any retained definition or is only a representation used for proof.
General energies on page 9 begin with k<2^p but the energy sum uses k<2^(j-1); pages 11-12 permute j,p,k subscripts. Keep exact originals and explain unresolved index conventions.
General scale-selection maxima do not repeat the coarse range and empty-set convention. Do not automatically transfer those conventions without source support.
The iteration updates eta using the current H estimate and the previous eta estimate; do not turn it into a simultaneous update.
Theorem 11 prints m_opt>m>1/(4H)-2H-1 for every interior H. Preserve the intermediate m and distinguish it from the preceding weaker displayed choice of m_opt.
Equation (36) uses W^{H,r} and the overloaded sum defined on page 31. Its multi-index entries are printed in {1,...,S}, versus {1,...,2S} in the earlier W/g definitions; preserve this discrepancy.

Appendix C defines the trigamma function used in a noise-moment bound; the original log-chi-square law on page 7 may suffice to define the variance without importing the appendix. Isserlis and appendix expansion remainders are not automatically estimator dependencies.
